title: India Invites Designs for BWF World Championships 2026 Mascot
indian_angle: India is set to host the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, and this competition engages Indian creativity in the event's branding.
summary: Badminton India has announced a mascot design competition for the upcoming BWF World Championships 2026, which will be held in India, inviting creative submissions to represent the global event.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway for World Championships
indian_angle: This camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently in progress at the National Centre of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, focusing on honing the skills of India's promising young shuttlers.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The course aims to elevate the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to enhance coaching expertise.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern one of India's key domestic team events, crucial for state-level competition and player identification.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining the rules and guidelines for the upcoming domestic competition.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change Notified for Junior Worlds Selection Trials
indian_angle: This change impacts the composition of potential Indian women's doubles pairs vying for a spot in the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification regarding a change in a Women's Doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been issued by BAI.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues and Tournaments
indian_angle: This advisory directly addresses concerns about unregulated events within India, protecting players and the sport's integrity.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released an advisory warning against participation in unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships, emphasizing the importance of sanctioned events.
